_about: Kept AI links: the #load links a chatbot writes from a page's agent.txt (SharedAgent in shared.js, _ref/ai-drive-plan.md). FROZEN like _ref/share-links.json: these links live on in people's chat histories, so add new ones and never change or remove one. A field renamed since is mapped by the tool (data-persist, or a migration in its load), never fixed here. Each link opens `page` with the fragment `link` and must hold `expect` (field key: the value as the input shows it) and, when given, `probe` (what the page's probe in _ref/agent-lib.mjs returns, matched in part; lists whole). `model`: true marks a whole custom model in json, which must also solve (A6). `via`: the address a link is opened at when it is not `page` itself (a router page that redirects, powerfactory-scripter/index.html); it must land on `page` and apply there. Checked by node _ref/agent-check.mjs.
